My name is Jackie Cruz, and I've dedicated over 30 years to the art of hairdressing and wellness coaching, with a special focus on supporting breast cancer survivors. As a stage three breast cancer survivor myself, I'm passionate about beauty and wellness and their transformative power. I established JCRUZstudio in my hometown Williamsburg, Brooklyn - a private, vegan haven where beauty and wellness meet through thoughtfully crafted experiences. Here, I exclusively use certified organic hair products made in Denmark to ensure clients receive safe, balanced and high-quality care every time.
My journey as a private hair Stylist to the world-renowned composer Paul Anka taught me invaluable lessons in style, color, and creativity and deepened my love for art expression. Now, I share this passion with my community, combining artistry and wellness to inspire those around me. My goal is to help build a stronger beauty & Wellness community, one head and canvas at a time by showing that clean, organic hair care isn't just effective but essential for personal and environmental well-being.
